text:
maria: quick check — we're planning a batch eval next Tue 10:00 UTC, estimate ~3h, need ~40 A100s (40GB) burst. Anyone have capacity visibility across clouds?
tyler: tagging infra-runbook — what's the fallback if cloud spot/TPUs are tight? dedicate on-prem or stagger runs?
olivia: cc @maria saw vendor email about limited regional stock next week. which regions are you planning?
maria: prefer us-central1 for lower latency to our infra, but can split us-west1 if needed. goal is minimize cross-region egress.
infra-bot: Automated quota snapshot for project rw-inference-prod: GPUs requested=0, GPUs allocated=24 (A100-40GB=8, T4=16), GPU quota remaining=16. Request history: last increase on 1748000000.
maria: thanks infra-bot — looks short. @gcp-sales can you check available preemptible A100 capacity in us-central1 for Tue 10-13 UTC? we just need a burst and can accept preemptible if we get enough nodes.
gcp-sales: Hi Maria — I pinged capacity ops. Preliminary: preemptible A100s are tight in us-central1 but us-west1 has ~50 available; cross-region spinning is fine if you can tolerate small latency bump. Need final confirmation by EOD Mon to reserve.
maria: ok, we can split 25 us-central + 15 us-west. Tyler, can you open a quota increase / reserve request for us-central1 to 40 GPUs and ask for burst reservation?
tyler: will do. raising internal ticket and vendor reserve. Internal command I used before: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=rw-inference-prod` to double-check quotas.
olivia: FYI there's an outstanding Dedicated capacity negotiation next quarter — might be a cheaper long-term path if these bursts recur.
maria: good note. For this run though we need fast action. @gcp-sales can you add a soft hold on 25 preemptible A100s in us-central1 and confirm us-west1 availability?
gcp-sales: put a soft hold for 24 A100-preemptible in us-central1 and confirmed 30 in us-west1. I'll follow up with the reservation link and an ETA for final confirmation.
maria: perfect — Tyler I'll update the run schedule to split nodes and add requeue if preemptions occur.
tyler: done — created ticket INFRA-2334 and requested quota bump + vendor reservation. pinging @olivia for procurement approval on vendor hold cost (~$1.4k/hr estimate).
olivia: approve provisional spend for this one-off. Can you attach the vendor quote in INFRA-2334?
tyler: attached. also added a short runbook note: ```
- if preemptions > 20% -> pause non-critical evals
- if quota not approved by Mon EOD -> stagger jobs into Wed
```
maria: thanks team. I'll post final run plan here once vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
gcp-sales: Confirmed reservation link sent to Tyler and Procurement. Will update if anything changes.
maria: closing the loop — last check: infra-bot snapshot after reserve?
infra-bot: Post-reservation snapshot: GPUs allocated=40 (A100-40GB=32 preemptible reserved=24), GPUs free=8, pending quota requests=1. Reservation status: soft-hold -> pending vendor confirmation.
maria: awesome, marking as green for scheduling.
